steamNotice: Steam games start through the Steam client, which picks the Proton version and ignores Platypus's env vars. To apply these settings, paste this into Steam → Properties → Launch options:

runner.nativeNote: This game ships a native Linux build from the store. It runs directly, without Proton — runner, DX layer and Proton flags don't apply.
runner.savedMissing: Saved runner is not installed. Pick another or the launch falls back to an error.
runner.noneInstalled: No Proton or Wine runners detected.

launch.workdirHint: Where the game runs. Empty means the executable's folder.
launch.prefixCustom: This prefix, for this game only. Empty falls back to the default prefix folder.
launch.prefixDefault: Empty: this game uses a folder of its own in the default prefix folder. The folder is created on demand.
launch.badKey: Letters, digits and _ only; cannot start with a digit

program.detectedNative: Detected as a native Linux program.
program.detectedWine: Detected as a Windows program (runs with Wine / Proton).
program.runHelp: Automatic follows what the file looks like; override it when detection gets it wrong.
